entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING
entities.description: ESM sublayer state in the network indicating that an EPS bearer context modification has been initiated towards the UE.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE
entities.description: ESM sublayer state where the EPS bearer context is active.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: ESM sublayer state where the EPS bearer context is inactive.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Network-initiated message to modify an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT/REJECT
entities.description: UE response to MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, including cause value #43.

entities.name: Cause value #43
entities.description: Specific cause value used in MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT/REJECT and other messages.

relations.description: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message transitions the network from BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE to BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT/REJECT message with cause value #43 transitions the network from BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING to BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE state.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT/REJECT message includes condition for cause value #43.
